headword: {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}

definitions.explanation: A person's natural aptitude for sports and physical activities. Literally means "motor nerves" but is used colloquially to mean general athletic talent or physical coordination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm bad at sports because I'm not physically coordinated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧で、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}する→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: My older sister has outstanding athletic ability and quickly improves at any sport.

notes:
{運動神経|うんどうしんけい} literally means "motor nerves" (⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ = movement + ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ = nerves). In medical contexts it refers to the actual motor nervous system, but in everyday usage it refers to a person's natural athletic talent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (to be athletic / physically coordinated)
- {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to be unathletic / uncoordinated)
- {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧ (to have slow reflexes)
- {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧ (outstanding athletic ability)

USAGE:
This is a very common expression in daily conversation. Japanese people frequently describe themselves or others as having good or bad {運動神経|うんどうしんけい}. It encompasses overall physical coordination, not just speed or strength.
